hero.title: A focused desktop media downloader.
hero.desc: Download video, audio, playlists, thumbnails, and timestamp screenshots from YouTube and other yt-dlp-supported sites when you are authorized to save them.

downloads.label: Downloads
downloads.title: Choose your installer.
downloads.desc: Official builds are loaded directly from the latest GitHub release.
downloads.notInRelease: Installer pending in the latest release.
downloads.couldNotLoad: Release pending — view GitHub for status

features.label: Capabilities
features.title: The control you need. Nothing you do not.
features.desc: Analyze links, choose formats, and manage the queue without working in a terminal.
features.metadataDesc: See an immediate preview while full metadata and available formats load in the background.
features.formatDesc: Choose video, audio, thumbnails, or timestamp screenshots with clear output options.
features.playlistDesc: Inspect a playlist and select the exact items you want before the queue starts.
features.queueDesc: Pause, resume, cancel, or retry downloads and keep completed work organized.
features.wizardDesc: The required downloader and JavaScript runtime are bundled and verified. No separate Python or system yt-dlp installation is required.
features.historyDesc: History and preferences stay on your device and can be removed whenever you choose.

screenshots.label: Interface
screenshots.title: Made to stay out of your way.
screenshots.desc: Actual application captures in its monochrome dark theme.
screenshots.homeCaption: Paste a URL and get a responsive media preview.
screenshots.formatCaption: Choose quality, format, and output type.
screenshots.playlistCaption: Select individual items from a batch.
screenshots.queueCaption: Track progress and recover failed jobs.

workflow.label: Workflow
workflow.title: From link to file in four steps.
workflow.step1Desc: Run the installer and confirm the first-run system check.
workflow.step2Desc: Add a supported media URL and review the preview.
workflow.step3Desc: Choose output type, quality, and destination.
workflow.step4Desc: Start the job and manage it from the persistent queue.

releaseNotes.coreDesc: Electron, a supported Node.js runtime, and a checksum-verified yt-dlp build are included.
releaseNotes.ffmpegDesc: Install it for high-quality stream merging, MP3 conversion, metadata, and screenshots.
releaseNotes.unsignedDesc: Commercial code signing is not currently included, so your operating system may show a warning.

trust.label: System & trust
trust.title: Know exactly what you are installing.
trust.desc: Desktop Media Downloader is open source, requires no app account, and keeps its history and preferences in local application storage.
trust.responsibleDesc: Only download media you are authorized to save. The app is not intended to bypass DRM, paywalls, or access controls.
trust.browserDesc: Browser-cookie access is disabled by default and is used only when you explicitly choose a browser for authenticated media.

footer.projectDescription: Small tools for better desktop workflows.
footer.warning: Open-source builds are not currently commercially code-signed. Verify downloads against the official GitHub release.

modal.title: About installer warnings
modal.body: Your download has started. Windows and macOS may show a trust warning because Desktop Media Downloader isn't commercially code-signed — that's a signing cost issue, not a safety issue.
modal.check1: Only use links from this page or official GitHub releases.
modal.check2: Compare release tags and commits in the repo.
modal.check3: Read the source if you want full confidence.
